Vemabhūpālacarita
or Vīranārāyaṇacarita. a. account of the life of Vīranārāyaṇa (1403-20 A. D., Reddy king of Addankki. by Vāmana Bhaṭṭabāṇa or Abhinava Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa, son of Kova(ma)ṭi Yajvan. A prose reomance in 4 paricchedas.
See S. N. Dasgupta, HSL. Classical Perriod, Vol. I. p.. 433. 754. [Page265-b]
Adyar II. p. 26 (2 mss; inc.). Adyar D. V. 1211 (inc.). Adyar PL. p. 132. Burnell 162a. Gough p. 144 (a.). IO. 7350. MD. 12423. R. A. Sastri I. p. 27. RORI. III. B. 6588. Extr. p. 141. TD. 4025. Trav. Uni. Sup. 17741. VVRI. I. p. 316 (inc.).
Pt.. in (1). Śrīvāṇī Vilāsa Skt. Ser. no. 16, Srirangam, 1910. (2). Laghugadya saṅgraharatnamālā, no. 1. Kumbhakonam, 1921.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1164. 1496; IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 2950.

Vemabhūpālīya
(sic) a C. on an. of the works of Vemabhūpāla. Deśamaṅgalam 1031.

Vemānabhairava
alias Bhairavārya alias Bhairavāvadhānin, also called Nemāna alias Nemāni. (pertains to Taittirīyasaṃhitā; deals with Prātiśākhyas an. Śikṣās, divided into various sns, such a. Saṃjñāprakaraṇa.).
See Aithal, Vedic Ancillary Lit. p. 488.
